description: This file defines a report for asset depreciations and balances in the ERPNext system. It includes functions to fetch asset category data, individual assets, and generate report columns. The main function executes the report logic, calculating various depreciation and asset value metrics based on filters like date ranges.

methods.name: execute(filters=None)
methods.description: Main entry point for generating the asset depreciation report; returns columns and data based on filters.

methods.name: get_columns(filters)
methods.description: Generates the list of column definitions for the report, dynamically formatting date labels.

methods.name: get_data(filters)
methods.description: Fetches and processes asset category data and individual asset details to compile report rows.

methods.name: get_asset_categories(filters)
methods.description: Retrieves aggregated asset category data such as costs and quantities within date ranges.

methods.name: get_assets(filters)
methods.description: Retrieves depreciation details for assets grouped by category, including accumulated depreciation and depreciation during the period.
